d: Ready to strengthen risk oversight across UAE Wealth products and distribution?

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

As Senior Wealth Risk Manager in the UAE you’ll support the Head of Wealth Risk and MENAT IWPB CRO to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risks across the market Wealth business. The role provides focused second-line oversight across investment and wealth products, their distribution journeys, risk governance and the implementation of the Risk Management Framework.

Working closely with first-line product, distribution and business teams and with specialist second-line Risk Stewards you’ll provide practical advice and independent oversight to inform key decisions. You’ll help ensure material risks and issues are understood, escalated and addressed in a timely way.
Success means clear governance, decision-useful risk reporting and sustained improvements in controls, issue management and customer outcomes.
q: A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory
Relevant risk management experience from private banking, wealth management or another regulated financial services business is essential.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of investment and wealth products alongside product governance and distribution frameworks
Working knowledge of risk governance, risk appetite, the Risk Management Framework and non-financial risk management is required.
Experience supporting governance forums including preparing senior-level papers and briefings and tracking issues and actions is required.
Operate effectively in a regulated environment with a strong understanding of the regulatory environment for Wealth business
Use structured approaches to interpret complex information, identify connections and emerging risks and communicate practical conclusions clearly
Provide effective independent challenge across stakeholders at different levels of seniority, using clear and professional judgement
Work effectively in a complex matrix environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail

This is a role with real influence on how Wealth products are governed, distributed and monitored in market. You’ll help senior decision-makers see risk clearly and act early on issues that matter to customers, regulators and the business. If you’re looking to build deeper second-line oversight across investment and wealth products and shape practical improvements in controls and governance this role offers breadth, scale and visibility. Join HSBC and help keep the UAE Wealth business safe, well-governed and ready for growth.
For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number.
